capsuleTopic.title: Heavenly Assembly
capsuleTopic.subtitle: Council · throne · worship · judgment · commission · access
capsuleTopic.orientation: Trace scenes where Scripture depicts God enthroned, presiding, judging, commissioning, or receiving worship amid heavenly beings—and keep explicit gatherings distinct from inference.
capsuleTopic.trailPrompt: Follow who gathers, who speaks, who is sent, who worships, who is judged, and how humans enter the heavenly scene.

passages.phase: Sons of God and contested belonging

passages.title: The LORD comes with ten thousands of holy ones

passages.observation: The LORD punishes the high army and earthly kings, then reigns on Zion with glory before his elders.

passages.title: True prophets stand in the LORD’s council

passages.title: Cherubim carry the departing glory

passages.title: Zion gathers angels, firstborn, Judge, and mediator
